look_here_first: Look for a low creeping wetland mat with fleshy, small, sessile oblong-to-obovate leaves and solitary pale blue-white flowers arising from the leaf axils.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: small sessile fleshy oblong to obovate leaves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: corolla white to bluish/pinkish and weakly 2-lipped

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: 5 deeply divided calyx lobes with unequal outer/inner lobes

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: small ovoid capsule retained within persistent calyx

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Low mat-forming aquatic to semiaquatic herb; stems creep and root at nodes.

key_traits.label: Leaf morphology
key_traits.text: Small fleshy sessile oblong, obovate or spatulate leaves with rounded tips.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Solitary axillary flowers, pale blue/white/pinkish, with a short fused corolla and four stamens.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Small ovoid capsule within the persistent calyx.

key_traits.label: Joey field note
key_traits.text: Joey's San Marcos River frames pair the creeping succulent habit with a close flower view, making the axillary flower plus fleshy-leaf combination easy to memorize.
